THEWITCH-SMOLDER.title: Smolder
THEWITCH-SMOLDER.description:

THEWITCH-INCANT.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Apply {HexPower:diff()} [gold]Hex[/gold] if you have used a [gold]Potion[/gold] this turn.
